cost_note: This clean-room restart keeps the original method, records, and gates. Its ceilings deduct every incident-ledger attempt from the originally approved cumulative ceilings: at most 860 additional physical attempts and 219602107 additional reserved-or-reported tokens.

evaluation.primary: published objective/status benchmark accuracy and paired transitions

selection.selection_rule: All development_propose/development_select Base records at replicate 17 and 65536 tokens, except transport interruptions. Stage 1 takes fixed benchmark quotas and the lexicographically first record from distinct operational families; Stage 2 contains every remainder.
selection.source_status_filter: exclude only four Base transport interruptions; retain model-format failures

stage_rules.final_development: Promising only with at least 10 corrections and at most 2 regressions versus Base, corrections at least four times regressions, at least 5 correcting operational families, and at least 5/at most 2 incremental corrections/regressions versus V6.
stage_rules.stage1: Continue only with zero infrastructure-unavailable FullV7 cases, at least 5 accepted dual-view consensus models, at least 3 corrections and at most 1 regression versus Base, net at least 2, and at least 2 correcting operational families.
